justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/InvokeDynamic.java`: `ForInterceptedMethodParameters` is a singleton enum with only two trivial methods, `resolve(...)` and `prepare(...)`. `resolve(...)` just builds a `Resolved.Simple` from `MethodVariableAccess.allArgumentsOf(instrumentedMethod)` and the parameter erasures, while `prepare(...)` is an identity return. The nested type has no branching, no fields, and no separate responsibilities, so it does not show insufficient modularization.
